page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this hardware profile, making it reliant entirely on the dedicated Intel Xeon processor for all computational tasks.

With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfg8i.2xlarge is structured for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for applications requiring consistent CPU performance without the burstable limitations of shared-core instances. Typical workloads include mid-sized web servers, application servers, containerized microservices, and development environments.
